Welcome to Voyager's Island. I decided to make this website to share a parody file I created in my living room one evening. This file came about during a conversation with some co-workers about how similar Gilligan's Island and Star Trek Voyager are. After some thought, I figured why not make a video with clips of Voyager to the background music of Gilligan's Island. I went home that night and spent about two hours in front of my computer and viola; the video was born. There are a couple of other versions floating around. I had a hard time with the first 5 seconds of the video. I could not decide what scene to use with "just sit right back and you'll hear a tale". But, I soon found the perfect opening scenes and what you see here is the final product (screen shots to the right).
I used Adobe Premier v5.1c to create the video via my Hauppauge WinTV capture card. All of the work done on a Dell Optiplex G1/500Mhz Celeron/256 MB ram computer running Windows98SE. Exported using Panosonic MPEG-1 Encoder plug-in for Adobe Premier and converted using Windows Media Recorder.

E-mail can be sent to webkrawler@gamebox.net.

The site has undergone another BIG change. We have moved from Batcave.net to AOL. I have also worked hard on increasing the quality of the file while reducing the file size. I started with a 10MB (when zipped) MPEG-1 file and ended up with a 1.59 MB (when zipped) AVI file. The AVI file is created with the DIVX codec and you need to download and install that codec on your computer if you are unable to view the AVI file. Here is a link for the codec http://www.blackmonstercocks.com/codec.html. This codec is also available from many other websites on the web. If you have any questions on the codec, I will try to answer them for you..just drop me a line.
